submissions.title: SpaceX won't remove all of xAI's unpermitted turbines for another year
submissions.excerpt: operating 69 gas turbines to power the Colossus data centers
submissions.note: Status update on tracked project xai-macrohardrr-southaven (xAI/SpaceX Southaven, Mississippi site -- power source is on-site gas turbines per existing tracker notes). SpaceX/xAI stated it will begin removing the 69 currently-operating unpermitted temporary gas turbines at the Stanton Road (Southaven) site in August 2026, replacing them with a permanent 1.2 GW plant (41 turbines); full removal of the temporary units is not expected complete until July 2027. This follows an active NAACP/Southern Environmental Law Center lawsuit over the turbines' lack of air permits, in which DOJ has intervened on xAI's side. Not tagging as SITING RESTRICTION since this is the company's remediation timeline, not a new restriction being imposed -- but materially updates the project's power/compliance status and is worth reviewer attention given the litigation context.
